surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of ZrCl4 and H2O or H2O-H2O2 on Si(100) substrates, leading to the formation of ZrO2 films. The growth mechanism is surface-controlled with alternating pulses of precursors, resulting in self-limiting submonolayer-by-submonolayer growth. The reaction steps include the adsorption of ZrCl4, followed by the reaction with surface hydroxyl groups, and subsequent regeneration of hydroxyl sites through a water pulse.
